reproduce.serve: python -m http.server 8123 --bind 127.0.0.1 -d dist   (after: npm run build)
reproduce.note: The recorder gates the screencast on window.__REPLICA_READY__ and stops on window.__REPLICA_DONE__, so load time is excluded and the clip length matches the cue.

recordedRun.mode: ?record=1&quad=1 — deterministic single pass, quad preview and HUD visible

fixesAlreadyAppliedDuringConstruction: Azimuth feathering was a fraction of the state, so FULL_FIELD faded to black across its own last 30% and was not full. Replaced with fixed radian feathers and out-of-range FULL_FIELD extents.
The HUD reported only state occupancy, so in front-window mode it read 100% while the fitted source window covered ~46% of the azimuth. It now reports state occupancy and window coverage separately.
?record=1 advanced the cue at a fixed 1/30 per frame, completing the 32s cue in ~16s of wall time. It now uses real elapsed time so the clip matches the cue.
